reasoning: Client hospitality dinner per Figure 2 (fig2-dining). The note states the business purpose (integration API discussion), the external organization (Veloce Mobility), and the attendee count (3 total, 2 external), satisfying the documentation requirements of Chapter 8, so it is not downgraded to solo dining. Attendee ratio is 2 external per 1 employee, meeting the at-least-1-external-per-employee rule. Dinner cap is EUR 90 per attendee; the EUR 225 pre-tip bill divided by 3 attendees is EUR 75.00, within the cap. The truffle line (Iberico Pluma with Truffle Polenta) is a main course at EUR 34.50 unit price, strictly below the EUR 40.00 threshold in Figure 3 Step 3 (fig3-truffle), so it is reimbursable. Receipt time 21:42 is before the 23:00 late-night cutoff in Figure 2, so the bill is not rejected as a late-night expense. No alcohol was ordered, so the 30% alcohol allowance is not implicated. The EUR 25.00 tip is within the German 20% cap (20% of the EUR 225.00 pre-tip bill = EUR 45.00) from the Global Tipping table (tip-de-table). The EUR 35.92 tax is the 19% VAT-inclusive portion of the EUR 225.00 subtotal, not a separately added charge, so it needs no line of its own. The receipt is dated Thursday 2024-05-16, so no weekend or holiday screening under Figure 1 applies. Every line is fully reimbursed.
